Aur jab sitare jhar paren ge.
Aur jab samandaron ko abal diya jaye ga.
Aur jab qabrein akhar di jayen gi.
Us waqt har shaks ko pata chal jaye ga ke us ne kiya aage bheja aur kiya peechhe chhora.
Ae insan ! Tujhe kis cheez ne apne us Parwardigar ke maamle mein dhoka laga diya hai jo bara karam wala hai.
Jis ne tujhe paida kya phir tujhe theek theek banaya, phir tere andar aitadaal paida kya ?
Jis surat mein chaha, us ne tujhe jor kar tayyar kiya.
Hargiz aisa nahin hona chahiye. Lekin tum jza o saza ko jhutlate ho.
Halaanke tum par kuchh nigraan (farishte) muqarrar hain.
Jo tumhare sare kaamon ko jante hain.
Yaqeen rakho ke nek log yaqeenan bari nematon mein hon ge.
Aur badhkaar log zaroor dozakh mein hon ge.
Woh us mein jza o saza ke din dakhil hon ge.
Aur woh us se gayab nahin sakte.
Aur tumhein kya pata ke jza o saza ka din kya cheez hai ?
Haan tumhein kya pata ke jza o saza ka din kya cheez hai ?
Yeh woh din hoga jis mein kisi dusre ke liye kuchh karna kisi ke bas mein nahin hoga, aur tamam tar hukum us din Allah hi ka chale ga.
